description: Master index of BRANCH-001 contract fixtures. Each entry maps to an outcome table file. Tests in BRANCH-002+ must validate all cases in all tables.

required_invariants: Inheritance is a read rule, never physical duplication.
Retraction in any branch in the child-to-root path shadows ancestor assertions.
Branch-neutral record kinds readable without membership check (§27.16).
Four-valued; both must never be collapsed.
Fluency, majority, or narrative coherence is never a tie-breaker.
scope_difference, temporal_change, perspective_divergence are never automatically logical_contradiction.
is_logical_contradiction=true requires same scope, same proposition, opposite polarity.
Merge must never silently choose a winner.
Conflicting claims remain unresolved in output.
Branch-neutral sources may share IDs without membership reconciliation (§27.16).
Fluency or coherence is never a tie-breaker on both.
Causal hypothesis generation never promotes beyond candidate.
abstain policy: output_claims must be empty.

acceptance_tests_required.description: Child retracts parent Claim — omitted from its default view; parent unchanged (inherit-003)
acceptance_tests_required.expected_result: retracted in child; parent view unchanged

acceptance_tests_required.description: Affirmative and negative evidence in same scope — both, no explosion (support-003)
Same claim, incompatible scopes — not a logical contradiction (conflict-002)
Two perspectives disagree — preserved as divergence (conflict-003)
Merge conflicting branches — MergeAssessment lists unresolved conflict (merge-003)
Inference encounters both — preserve/branch/clarify/abstain with explicit reason (infer-002 to infer-005)
acceptance_tests_required.expected_result: Policy-specific safe behavior; never implicit winner selection

acceptance_tests_required.description: Source reused in two branches — one source identity; distinct branch-local interpretations (inherit-006, merge-006)
acceptance_tests_required.expected_result: Source fragment shared; branch Claims have distinct membership

open_decisions.description: Scope hierarchy rule for inheritance compatibility is unspecified; needs parent scope matching semantics.
BranchEnsemble weight normalization algorithm is task-relative but unspecified. Consumer must supply in Phase 1.
